title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Berry Recruitment is currently seeking a highly motivated and professional Conveyancing Assistant to join a well-established organisation based in Abingdon.

This position is ideal for individuals with experience in law or property who are looking to apply their skills within a forward-thinking law firm.

The successful candidate will be a professional who has previous property experience. They will be proactive and have solid experience of dealing with all routine residential property completion matters. They will have knowledge of standard conveyancing forms, draft contracts, transfers, OS1s and K15s. They will be prepared to implement best practice to create a streamlined service. They will provide excellent front-line support to the residential property teams and be a professional and efficient first point of contact to clients.

Role: Conveyancing Assistant

Salary: 25,000 - 30,000 Per Annum

Location: Abingdon

Hours: 9:00 am - 5:00 pm, Full time / Permanent 35 hours

Key Responsibilities of the Conveyancing Assistant:
- Supporting the existing completions team to deliver a high standard of completions work including but not limited to:
- Handling all aspects of the deal after exchange up to completion
- Land Registry matters
- Liaising with mortgage companies
- Management company liaison
- Knowledge of SDLT submission process
- Carrying out registrations for the busy team which include complex applications e.g., first registrations, lease extensions, removal of notices alongside straightforward transfers
- General administration including but not limited to drafting completion statements, producing letters and documents which utilise case management and IT systems
- Dealing with client enquiries
- Receiving instructions, ordering searches, requesting redemption figures
- Proactive diary management including making appointments, prioritising and arranging meetings
- Processing daily emails, post and voice messages on behalf of the fee earner
- Filing, photocopying, cheque requests, faxing, dead filing, DX & post preparation
- Meeting with clients face to face, to help administer and progress matters as instructed by the supervising solicitor
- Providing clients with updates in relation to the day-to-day relevant matters via phone, email and face to face
- Ensure high quality communication with the company's internal teams and individuals
- Reporting faulty equipment / software to appropriate parties
- Attending relevant team meetings
- Participating in other activities and projects; flexibility as required
- Carrying out any other reasonable task that may be requested by the supervising solicitor

About you:
- A well-organised and flexible person
- A person who can be proactive and work under pressure
- An efficient and effective administrator
- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong written and oral communication skills
- Takes responsibility for their own work
- Ability to deal with competing priorities and meet deadlines
- Shows understanding of client's needs and tailors service appropriately
- Calm and confident team player with good interpersonal skills

No candidate will meet every single desired qualification we have listed. If your experience looks a little different but you think you can role; value to the role, we'd love to learn more about you!"

title: Legal Assistant - Conveyancing
description:
Berry Recruitment are NOW hiring for a committed and experienced Legal Assistant - Conveyancing to work for a boutique Legal firm in Wantage.

The successful candidate will be a professional who has previous property experience. They will be proactive and have solid experience of dealing with all routine residential property completion matters. They will have knowledge of standard conveyancing forms, draft contracts, transfers, OS1s and K15s. They will be prepared to implement best practice to create a streamlined service. They will provide excellent front-line support to the residential property teams and be a professional and efficient first point of contact to clients.

Role: Legal Assistant - Conveyancing

Location: Wantage, Oxfordshire

Hours: Office based. Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm

Key Responsibilities of the Legal Assistant - Conveyancing:
- Ordering property searches.
- Dealing with ID/AML procedures and requirements.
- Working directly with clients to ensure a seamless service.
- Drafting contract packs and client care letters.
- Assisting the clients, developers, and brokers with any queries either by telephone or email.
- Sending standard correspondence to clients.
- Drafting Stamp Duty Land Tax form in preparation for report to client.
- Write to clients and solicitors confirming exchange.
- Obtain OS2 and Bankruptcy searches and downloading the search results onto case file and lender portals.
- Obtain closing statements from clients and order ISA/LISA funds.
- Order redemption statements from lenders on sales.
- On completion ensure submission and payment of SDLT is made to HMRC.
- Arranging completion letters to client and solicitors, sending deeds etc on sales to solicitors.
- Submitting END1s/DS1s to existing lenders/HTB on sales.
- Submit the AP1 to Land Registry to register clients as new proprietors.
- Responding to Requisitions raised by the Land Registry.
- Send title documents to lenders and clients.

About you:
- Experience with using digital audio systems.
- Experience with working in conveyancing is preferred.
- Exceptional customer service.
- Able to type a decent speed as quite fast-paced environment.

No candidate will meet every single desired qualification we have listed. If your experience looks a little different but you think you can bring value to the role, we'd love to learn more about you!"

title: Private Client Paralegal
company: GWR Legal Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Private Client Paralegal - Abingdon - Oxfordshire

Superb progression prospects for aspiring trainee Solicitors/Legal Executives.

A fantastic opportunity has come up for an ambitious legal assistant/paralegal to join a Solicitors Practice in the Abingdon area of Oxfordshire.

The successful candidate will be joining the firms highly regarded private client team, who have an outstanding reputation in the Oxfordshire area for dealing with the broad range of private client matters including things like wills, probate, LPAs and court of protection matters.

The exact duties of the role will be tailored around the experience of the individual but will entail providing support to fee earners in the team and may include tasks such as:-
- Dealing with the opening and closing of files, ensuring all ID, AML and compliance checks are completed
- Handling new business enquiries within the team
- Meeting with clients alongside lawyers within the team to receive instructions and advise on their legal issue.
- Keeping clients updated on their matters or clarify points, chase information up over the phone, email or post
- Drafting wills and LPAs under supervision (with training and support given where needed)
- Assisting lawyers within the team with Court of Protection and probate matters.
- Land registry searches.
- Administration duties such as the typing/production of letters, relevant forms and documents.

Experience of working within the area of private client within a law firm would be beneficial but not essential if experience in other areas of law can be demonstrated.

Working alongside experienced lawyers in the team, within one of the areas strongest specialist private client teams, you will receive supervision and training and have the opportunity to develop your skills and knowledge in this specialist area of law. You will be someone who is eager and ambitious to learn and take on increasing levels of responsibility within the team as your experience develops.

Superb progression prospects will be made available to whoever comes into the team with encouragement and support over time to progress and qualify as a Solicitor or Legal Executive.

I have recruited for this team previously at paralegal level and seen the progression prospects that were made available to the person who joined, who subsequently qualified as a Solicitor within the team. I would therefore have no hesitation in recommending them as a firm where someone can really fulfil their potential and get the support to develop their legal career in the area of private client.

The firm will offer an attractive benefits package including a good salary (based on experience and regularly reviewed to ensure it keeps pace with your development and responsibilities), 26 days annual leave a year and a generous Pension scheme amongst other perks.

If you are a private client paralegal in the Oxfordshire area and would be interested in hearing more about this role please apply ASAP using the links or get in touch with Greg Whittaker at GWR Legal Recruitment for further details.
